title: Home Buying & Property Cross-Feed Daily Correlation
dataSources: Mortgage-rate snapshots (`mortgage:rate`), property-listing and Zestimate data (`property:listing`), HOA fees (`hoa:fee`), property-tax installments (`propertytax:installment`), home-buying milestones (`homebuying:milestone`).
app: Mortgage-rate watchers, Zestimate exports, HOA-fee logs, and property-tax installment trackers streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, CSV exports, and personal checklists.
spl:
(index=personal sourcetype=mortgage:rate) OR (index=personal sourcetype=property:listing)
| bin _time span=1d
| eval feed=case(sourcetype="mortgage:rate","primary",sourcetype="property:listing","secondary",1=1,"other")
| stats count as events by _time feed
| chart sum(events) over _time by feed
description: Lines up daily volume from mortgage:rate and property:listing to see whether two home buying feeds move together.
value: When two related exports diverge — one busy, one silent — it usually means a connector broke on only one path.
implementation: Forward both `mortgage:rate` and `property:listing` into `index=personal` and compare daily counts on one chart.
visualization: Dual-line chart of daily events per sourcetype.
grandmaExplanation: It shows whether your two main home buying data feeds rise and fall together or if one of them quietly stopped keeping up.
